verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs say users can create webhooks that fire on internal events and send information to external systems (docs-68). Webhooks can also be set up programmatically through the API (docs-21), and there are runbook webhook steps and Signals webhook alert targets as further outbound channels (docs-71, docs-72). Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, details on payload signing/verification and retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
